limits: For rosé wine, the main grapes together: at least 90%
For red wine, the main grapes together: at least 50%
For red wine, each main grape: at most 90%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A South West France appellation, the only one in the Northern Basque Country and often called the smallest vineyard in France. About 70% of the wine is red, with Tannat and Cabernet Franc, plus 20% rosé and 10% white from Manseng and Courbu.
